scope: Post-round public-review allegations; not independent scientific verdicts or established misconduct. Original immutable role releases and audit rulings remain unchanged. No raw allegation delivered to a proposer and no fifth cycle authorized.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Correct the raw-code line locator**

The [pinned raw file](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/The-OpenROAD-Project/OpenROAD/3549d60529517dc82deb7f0ff769345e9a424911/src/rsz/src/policy/MeasuredVtSwapPolicy.cc) has only 288 lines, and its candidate-estimation loop is at one-based lines 254–263; the published locator extends through nonexistent line 301 and labels lines 273–282 as estimation even though they contain post-commit handling and `finishRun`. Since the proposal uses `N10b273-301` to support CLM-1001, readers cannot verify that observation from the stated location; update this record and the claim ledger to the actual lines.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Publish the verifier's analytical-check evidence**

The verifier relies on `runs/analytical-check.json` for the stated 4,096-case result, but that file is absent from this commit and from the verifier release manifest, which contains only the compliance, verification, and workflow files; unlike the proposer and challenger checks, no exact script or stdout is embedded elsewhere. Consequently the independent result supporting CLM-1005 cannot be traced or reproduced from the frozen release, so include the script/output with hashes or remove the unsupported check claim.
